title: Alps Alpine 3D CAD data for RK10J11E0034 (RK10J1_E.STEP, RK10J1_E.pdf, read-me)
note: Downloaded by the assistant on November 25, 2026 from the '3D CAD' link on the Alps Alpine product page for RK10J11E0034 and stored unchanged. The archive holds RK10J1_E.STEP (one solid, file dated February 2012), a 3D PDF and Alps's read-me. Model origin is the centre of the knob; z = 0 is the underside of the body; the knob occupies z = 0.9 to 1.8 mm with a 7.0 mm radius. Terminals: five blades 0.8 x 0.3 mm at x = -4, -2, 0, 2, 4 mm in the plane y = -7.5 mm, free from z = -0.1 to -2.0 mm; seen from the knob side they are 1, dummy, 2, dummy, 3. Mounting lugs: 1.0 x 0.3 mm at x = +/-5.0 mm, y = 2.0 to 3.0 mm, free from z = -0.2 to -2.0 mm.
